It is therefore concluded that this project would be consistent with the basic goals of the current State Implementation Plan to achieve the National Ambient Air Quality Standards.
The "Notice of Intent", for preferred alternate #5 as shown on the following page, gives evidence to FHWA that the air quality impact by the proposed project has been reviewed and approved by the Indirect Source Review Agency (DNR). As part of the "Notice of Intent" procedures, DNR has acknowledged the review of the Airport Spur Air Quality Report according to Misconsin Administrative Code, MR 154. The signed Notice of Intent and letter of review and comment on the Air Quality Report by DNR also states that the project will not result in violations of an approved control strategy nor will the project interfere with the attainment or maintenance of the National Ambient Air Quality Standards (MAAOS).
FINA adoption of this Final EIS constitutes determination that the project is consistent with the State Implementation Plan.
In conclusion, to the extent that the proposed spur provides for smooth, rapid flow of traffic to the airport and relieves congestion on other heavily traveled streets in the area, the construction of the Airport Spur will improve air quality. The Airport Spur and development at and around the airport is expected to lead to more intensive use of the area with a significantly heavier total traffic but should not cause significant deterioration of air quality in the area.
